pr_summary: Modernize DALI's public query interfaces to accept std::string_view instead of owned std::string objects when querying information about pipeline inputs, operators, and feed counts. This eliminates unnecessary string allocations and copies. Additionally, add a new public function GetOperator() that returns a pointer to the underlying operator object (or nullptr if not found) given an operator name. All existing query functions (GetReaderMeta, GetInputLayout, GetInputNdim, GetInputDtype, InputFeedCount) are updated to accept string_view. The internal container for input operator descriptors is changed to support heterogeneous lookup.

notes: This is NVIDIA DALI, a GPU-accelerated data loading and preprocessing library for deep learning. The fix modifies the executor and pipeline APIs to use std::string_view for more efficient string handling. The build requires CUDA toolkit and various NVIDIA libraries. Tests are built with Google Test framework. Python bindings are optional but commonly used. The project uses CMake as its primary build system with many optional components controlled by CMake flags.
